description: Formatter and linter for 30 languages in one binary and one config file

ready: Ready: HTML, JavaScript / TypeScript, CSS / SCSS / Less, JSON / JSONC, Markdown, Python, YAML, Shell, Dockerfile, SQL, Java, GitHub Actions, C#, PowerShell, TOML, XML, Go, CMake, Kotlin, Vue / Svelte, Terraform (HCL), Angular templates, INI / EditorConfig / .gitignore, Ruby, GraphQL and Protobuf.
